name: worktree-guard
description: Claude Code has no setting for worktree naming: omit `name` and EnterWorktree invents `zealous-noether-b3d7e1`, then derives the branch from it. This plugin denies that call and asks for a task-derived slug instead. It also refuses to resume a same-named worktree silently, which EnterWorktree otherwise does with its branch and uncommitted changes attached.
